incident-bot: PAGE FIRED — latency SLO burn detected for /v1/generate (us-east) · p95/p99 spike · 3 alerts in 120s · incident INC8001234567

pagerduty: Pager duty: routing to on-call alex.k · severity: P1 · please ack and investigate · https://pd.example/INC8001234567

alex.k: ACK — oncall here. Looking at graphs now. p95 climbed from ~320ms -> ~1.6s, p99 from ~900ms -> ~3.8s across text-gen routes. Seeing batcher queue depth jump and increased token latency traces.

marta: Noted. Any deploys in the last 15m? I can check release logs and canary if needed.

alex.k: No deploys on infra or runtime in last 30m. Telemetry: KV cache hit rate dropped ~ from 93% -> 54% on several hosts. Batcher sidecars show CPU saturation.

priya: I can kick a temporary traffic diversion to the smaller quantized variant (rwd-v1-small) which has lower tail latency. Also can scale batcher replicas. Want me to proceed? :raised_hands:

alex.k: Yes — do both. Start with traffic shift 20% -> 100% if it looks good. Run scaling: `kubectl scale deploy batcher -n inference --replicas=6` and warm the KV caches.

priya: Running now — command: `kubectl scale deploy batcher -n inference --replicas=6` · rolling out `traffic split:set /v1/generate rwd-v1-small=20%`

incident-bot: NOTE — automated warmup suggestion: prefetch top-50 prefixes to KV nodes for route /v1/generate · started warmup job job-id=warmup-8001234567

marta: Observability update: after 60s on the 20% split p99 on the small variant is ~1.2s vs 3.8s on baseline. End-to-end p99 for the whole route down ~30%.

priya: Increasing split to 60% now. If metrics keep improving will finish to 100%.

alex.k: Good. Also disabled a noisy autoscaler policy for that cluster that was causing oscillation: `kubectl annotate deployment batcher cluster.autoscaler.kubernetes.io/disabled=true` (temporary).

priya: Traffic shift to rwd-v1-small -> 100% complete. Batcher replicas now 6. Telemetry: p95 ~420ms, p99 ~780ms (steady for 2 minutes). User error rate unchanged (<0.1%).

alex.k: Mitigation achieved — tail latency reduced and SLO burn no longer accelerating. Keeping monitoring open for 30m. Opening follow-up ticket to eng-runtime: root cause = batcher-sidecar CPU contention + KV cache eviction pattern during burst; action items: capture heap/proc profiles, increase cache capacity, revisit autoscaler hysteresis. Ticket: RT-8001234567.

marta: I'll post an internal postmortem draft and coordinate customer-facing status page update. Priya, can you attach the warmup logs and the traffic-split commands to the ticket?

priya: Will do. Adding logs and timeline to RT-8001234567 now.

alex.k: Thanks all. Leaving incident in monitoring state — will hand off to morning rotation with notes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC8001234567 status -> mitigated (temporary). Automatic follow-up reminder in 8h for RCA and customer comms.
